all: {{FULL_VERIFICATION_COMMANDS: Go and TypeScript lint, typecheck, test, build}}
verify.mutation: {{OPTIONAL: mutation command for the changed files; remove if the project has none}}

contract.spec: {{PATH: the OpenAPI file generated from Go, e.g. apps/api/openapi.yaml}}
contract.generateSpec: {{COMMAND: regenerates the spec from the Go code}}
contract.generateClient: {{COMMAND: regenerates the TypeScript client and the test mocks from the spec}}

paths: {{BACKEND_PATHS: e.g. apps/api/, modules/, db/migrations/, and the spec file}}
onStop: {{FAST_GO_COMMANDS: run when the backend builder stops, e.g. go vet ./... and go test for the touched modules}}

paths: {{FRONTEND_PATHS: e.g. apps/panel/, apps/employee/, packages/ui/, the generated client}}
onStop: {{FAST_TS_COMMANDS: run when the frontend builder stops, e.g. typecheck and vitest run for the touched app}}

ui.testData: {{TEST_DATA: which records agents may create and change}}
ui.writesProduction: {{true if the dev server writes to a production database}}

orca.workerPermissionMode: {{OPTIONAL: the mode Orca workers launch in, e.g. bypassPermissions; remove to use the orchestrator's own mode}}
